title.orig: An Act Declaring August 11 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the City of Iligan, Province of Isabela in Commemoration of Its Charter Day Anniversary to Be Known as “Iligan City Charter Day”

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2016/ra_10768_2016.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: August 11 of every year is declared a special working holiday in the City of Ilagan, Province of Isabela in commemoration of its Charter Day Anniversary to be known as “Ilagan City Charter Day”. When the holiday fells on a Saturday or a Sunday, the special working day shall be observed on the Monday that follows.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
